chapter: Mandeville, Bunk Johnson and society banquets
title: Isidore Fritz as clarinetist and musicians left in Mandeville
summary: George describes Isidore Fritz as one of the best clarinet players, his family, and says he doesn't know who plays in Mandeville now.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Who were the great clarinetists? Favorites and rivals

blocks.x: Let's see, we were talking about across the lake. Isidore Fritz again, says, those people that aren't living, I mean we like to keep harping on them sometimes because they can't talk for themselves. Was he older much than you? I thought maybe he was an older man when you first heard him.
Yeah, Isidore was an older man than I was.
But then you said he was just learning though too in that band that Bunk taught. I didn't know that before.
He was an older man than I was.
Yeah. What I'm talking about now when Bunk was teaching that band, that was when I was a boy going back and forth every year.
That's before you really lived over there.

Before I really lived over there. That band moved it on after they left Manneville, they moved it on into Baton Rouge. And they came back to Manneville. And that's where I found out how much a clarinet player Isidore was. Isidore was about one of the best I can say I ever heard. But he never would leave me all in. He never would leave that? I mean he never would come over here to play with me all in. Yeah, he never would come over here.
I don't know. He never would come over here. And he played the clarinet, his father played the bass, and the brother Lloyd played the trombone.
He's a dead now of course. He's a dead now, of course.

Yeah, he died in Covington. The last time I saw him I played out that neighborhood with someone. Well he wasn't playing much and he had a lot of work, they were bricklayers. And he was doing contract and work.
Maybe Dan Moody might know the family.
Yeah, probably some of the relatives are still over there.
Yeah, Dan may know the whole family. Well I knew some of the family but because Dan was really not from Manneville, Dan was from Slider.
Are there any musicians left in Mandeville that you know of? I tell you, I don't really know who's left over there.
It's been so long since I've been over there. I don't know who's over there.
